name: Convincing Lies (Su)
body:
Prerequisite: Saboteur 4

Benefit: The saboteur’s falsehoods fool even magical detection. The saboteur is warded against magical means of detecting lies or forcing her to speak the truth, as if she was under the effect of a glibness spell using her saboteur level as her caster level. Unlike the normal glibness spell, she does not receive any bonuses to her Bluff check from this ability.
